_intro_male_1.text: Welcome to Smart Dictation — a zero-cost ($0), one hundred percent open-source GitHub Pages web system started on October 22 (2 weeks ago) to make English dictation effortless and lag-free on any device.

_intro_male_2.text: Your privacy is one hundred percent protected: no personal data is ever shared, no unnecessary data is collected, and all session diagnostics and reviews are end-to-end encrypted.

_intro_male_3.text: Lecturers update classroom words anytime through the automated Lecturer Mode — and because I built this using critical thinking with limited formal IT training, please share a quick voice or text review after your session if you spot anything to improve.

_intro_male_4.text: Created by Hansana after A/L Combined Maths, Physics, and Chemistry — powered by autonomous AI agents on my own system alongside my GitHub RDB project and flagship IT project. Enjoy your session!

note: Clips ship as b64 only; the app hydrates data URLs in memory. The four _intro_male_* Project Briefing beats are committed real warm British-male audio (preview narrator baked at release); autoEnsureSystemClips() re-synthesizes any missing or text-drifted system clip with the configured ElevenLabs George key on the next Studio unlock or Publish & Sync. Only Dictation Words are ever updated manually.
